posts.subject: eh... savagelord ban, thingy
posts.bodyHtml:
So eh, I'm super sorry for saying racist shit, and in general just being a troll.
I've learned from my actions, and it wont happend again.
I honestly hope you guys can forgive me.
If not, that's obviously fine, and I can understand it..



- Savagelord 🙂

You had other perm ban before this but I will give you a second chance at your ban is changed to 12h insted of Perma ban.


After this period ends show us your positive side and don't be as disrespectful towards other players as this wll be your last chance to show your good side.


You will be able to play again with us at 12:02 am


Kind Regards


Michal "OxygeN" J.


@Nachtfrische @BlackFire @Sky


//EDIT: Next time try not to swear in your apology.
[closesnew*]
